comments: Went back for a second look at the 1st Summer mRFF. It hovered regularly, and swooped low over the grassland catching insects. As the wind strengthened it sought shelter in the lee of bushes, and spent time on the ground. It was quite hobby like in the air, but looked longer tailed, especially when in hover mode. Some excellent images have been posted on facebook.
Adult and two juveniles. One of the juveniles decided to perch about 2 metres away from me at one point! I don't think I will ever get this close to one ever again!

Seen circling over Threipmuir reservoir. Several times it flew off down Green Cleugh and returned some time later from the ENE, presumably having done a loop by Loganlea/Glencourse reservoirs.
Saw it dive and catch a fish, and fly off to the west with it while being harassed by gulls.

Spent a lot of time catching insects, hovering for periods before landing on the ground and running along.
